user.title: Add network storage
user.description: Choose a name, storage purpose and protocol. Backup storage becomes a backup destination; media is mounted under /media and shared folders under /share. For SMB/CIFS, you can optionally paste a Windows Explorer path.

data.windows_path: SMB path copied from Windows Explorer (optional)

data_description.mount_name: Internal identifier for this location. Only letters, numbers, and underscores are allowed; for example: truenas_backups.
data_description.protocol: Choose SMB/CIFS for Windows or TrueNAS-style shares, or NFS for an NFS export.
data_description.windows_path: Optional SMB shortcut. Paste a Windows Explorer path, for example: \\truenas\backups\home-assistant. It fills the NAS address and remote share path in the next step.
data_description.usage: Choose backups for a backup destination, media for the media browser, or a shared folder for shared files.

smb.title: Connect SMB/CIFS storage
smb.description: Enter the access details for the selected SMB destination. When submitting, Home Assistant checks whether the mount can be activated. The destination folder is not created automatically.

data_description.server: Hostname or IP address of the NAS; for example: truenas.local or 192.168.1.20.
data_description.share: Remote share path. Subfolders are supported; for example: backups/home-assistant.
data_description.username: Account with write access to the selected SMB location; for example: homeassistant.
data_description.password: Password for the SMB account. It is sent to the Supervisor mount manager and is never exposed by this integration.
data_description.make_default: Use this location automatically as the default native Home Assistant backup destination.

nfs.title: Connect NFS storage
nfs.description: Enter the NFS server and its exported destination path. When submitting, Home Assistant checks whether the mount can be activated. The destination folder is not created automatically.

data_description.server: Hostname or IP address of the NAS; for example: truenas.local or 192.168.1.20.
data_description.path: Absolute path exported by the NFS server; for example: /mnt/tank/backups/home-assistant.
data_description.make_default: Use this location automatically as the default native Home Assistant backup destination.

error.invalid_mount_name: Use only letters, numbers, and underscores for the name.
error.invalid_server: Enter a hostname or IP address, not a path.
error.share_required: Enter the SMB remote share path.
error.invalid_nfs_path: The NFS export path must start with /.
error.invalid_remote_path: The network path must not contain . or .. path segments.
error.windows_path_cifs_only: A Windows Explorer path can only be used with SMB/CIFS.
error.invalid_windows_path: Enter a Windows network path starting with \\.
error.windows_path_needs_share: Use a share path such as \\server\share or \\server\share\subfolder.
error.mount_name_exists: A Supervisor mount already uses this name.
error.mount_target_exists: This network location is already configured by another Supervisor mount.
error.mount_not_active: The destination could not be mounted. Check that the path exists and that the account has access.
error.authentication_failed: The NAS rejected the supplied username or password.
error.permission_denied: The account does not have sufficient access to this storage location.
error.path_not_found: The selected network path does not exist.
error.mount_failed: The storage location could not be mounted. Check the server, path and access permissions.
error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not contact the Supervisor or NAS.
error.invalid_usage: Select backups, media, or a shared folder.

abort.supervisor_required: Network Storage Manager requires Home Assistant OS or a supervised installation.
